newsitem.title: USA: Economists divided on whether Fed will intervene.
newsitem.headline: Economists divided on whether Fed will intervene.

text.p: Economists were divided as to whether the Federal Reserve would intervene in the banking system on Wednesday.

Some saw the Fed as having sufficiently addressed its add need with recent operations, but others said an injection of reserves was still required, probably through a round of overnight system repurchase agreements.
The Fed also could add permanent reserves to the banking system via a coupon pass as early as this session, economists said.
Federal funds were trading at 5.44 percent, slightly below the Fed's current official target level of 5-1/2 percent.
